value.rationale: Two-block exchangeable SPD systems are a natural model for multigroup correlation/Hessian systems. The result replaces numerical diagonal-scaling optimization with an exact formula for arbitrary two-group sizes and strictly positive correlations, determines the global optimizer without imposing within-group equality, and exhibits two different active fluctuation constraints plus a dimension-independent optimal scaling in an infinite family. The exact parameter family has a provably strict improvement over ordinary unit-diagonal Jacobi equilibration; this is structural conditioning information rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
